verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm official Copilot Mobile apps exist on both iOS and Android and that connectors are available in them. Nothing in the evidence establishes that the apps are full-featured or match the web and desktop experience. missing for 10: documentation of mobile feature parity (voice, vision, Researcher/Analyst, Cowork and similar features on mobile), app-store or hands-on corroboration of the mobile apps' quality.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can use full-featured official mobile apps for iOS and Android

citations.quote: Copilot connectors are currently available on Copilot.com and on Copilot Mobile (iOS and Android)
